name: Navbar — mega menu
description: Sticky header with mega-menu panels: on lg+ panel entries open rich dropdowns (link groups with descriptions plus an optional featured card); below lg the burger opens a fullscreen overlay with the same content as an accordion and a sticky bottom CTA. Click to open (not hover), one panel at a time, Escape closes and restores focus, outside click closes; the plus rotates into a cross in CSS. React state + CSS only, no GSAP.

contentSlots.items: nav entries: plain { label, href } or { label, panel: { groups[], featured? } }
contentSlots.secondaryLink: quiet link before the CTA, optional
